item.title: Why Snapback Has a Free and a Pro Version
item.description: Snapback's core window management features are and always will be free. Here is what Pro adds, why the split exists, and how to decide which version is right for you.

item.title: Introducing Snapback: A Better Way to Manage Windows on Mac
item.description: Snapback is a free macOS window manager that saves and restores your entire workspace layout with one keystroke. Window snapping, multi-display support, and unlimited workspaces. No account needed.
